facts.business: Powerica Limited is an integrated power solutions company delivering end-to-end capabilities across the power generation value chain, offering diesel generator sets, medium-speed large generators, power generation solutions, wind power as an IPP, EPC and O&M services for Balance of Plant, and retrofit emission control devices through its associate Platino Automotive.

segments.name: Retrofit Emission Control Devices (via associate Platino Automotive)

capacity_or_capex.item: 52.7 MW wind power asset in Gujarat
~100 MW wind power asset in Gujarat

guidance_or_targets.statement: India targeting peak power demand of 458 GW by 2032
National Electricity Plan outlines investment of Rs 9.15 lakh crore across central and state networks
DG market projected to grow from Rs 15,966 crore in 2026 to Rs 23,803 crore by 2030 at 10.50% CAGR
Data centre capacity projected to grow at 20.5% CAGR during FY 2025–30
EV charging infrastructure expected to expand from 3.6 GW to 10.8 GW at 24.6% CAGR

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: The Statutory Auditor's Report for FY 2025-26 does not contain any qualifications, reservations or adverse remarks.

key_risks: Business Concentration Risk: Substantial revenue from Generator Set Business exposes company to adverse developments in this segment
Supply Chain Risk: Dependence on key suppliers and strategic technology collaborations may expose company to supply chain disruptions
Project Execution Risk: Wind power projects exposed to risks relating to land availability, right-of-way approvals, regulatory clearances and execution timelines
Financial Risk: Growth plans and capex requirements may increase reliance on external financing
Market Risk: Changes in power demand, industry activity, infrastructure spending and energy market dynamics may affect business performance
Competitive Risk: Company operates in competitive markets facing competition from domestic and international players across business segments
Intellectual Property Risk: Inadequate protection of intellectual property rights may adversely affect operations and competitive position
